text: Hitler ordered that Greece, Sardinia and Corsica be defended at all costs. The experienced 1st Panzer Division was sent from France to Greece. By the end of June, German strength on Sardinia had doubled, to about ten thousand men. German torpedo boats were moved from Sicily to the Greek islands.
